name: ew-repo-scout
title_zh: GitHub 上替你翻遍 Skill 仓库的选型买手
tagline_zh: 别在 10 万仓库里大海捞针。输入你要做的事，它筛出能跑的 Skill、核对用法与差异，连实现证据都给你翻出来。
tagline_en: Stop drowning in 100k repos. Tell it what you need, it finds working Skills, checks usage & differences, and digs.
desc_en: 面向开发者和 AI 实践者，在 GitHub 找到满足需求的现成 Skill 或相似项目，并核对能力、使用方式、产品差异和实现证据。
why_zh: 不是关键词搜索，而是按能力缺口反向匹配。它会交叉比对 README、代码结构和 issue。
why_en: It matches by capability gap, not keywords. Cross-references READMEs, code structure, and issues to separate 'claims to work'.
limit_zh: 只找 GitHub 公开仓库；不评估 Skill 质量，只汇总证据；不给安装命令或运行结果。
limit_en: Scans public GitHub repos only; doesn't judge Skill quality, just aggregates evidence; stops at a shortlist with rationale—no install or run.
title_en: A GitHub scout that finds the right Skill for you
